reason: I would call the demo line and probably take the free call-log count, but I would not wire $2,000 in the first month to a one-man setup that has no live clients to show me yet. My calls are my revenue and I want to see it work for somebody else first.
objection: The Québec French. If it sounds like a translated robot to a customer in Laval, I lose jobs, and nothing here shows me it working for a real shop. The setup is $2,000 up front and the refund only covers it if it catches 10 calls, so a $249 a month for a thing nobody has proven stays with me.
would_change_my_mind: A reference call with a plumber or HVAC owner in Laval or Montréal who is already live and will tell me how many calls it caught, plus a recorded night-time French call that sounds like a real person from here.
